notes.title: 🧠 Twice the Little Grey Cells with Detective Poirot & Royce
notes.notes:
Bonjour Detectives,

What connections do a terrible crime on a peaceful cruise on the Nile and a gruesome murder in the busy streets of London have? To unveil the truth on both investigations, Hercule Poirot found an ally in private detective Jane Royce. Together, they will join forces to solve the complex case of [i]Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile[/i], available on [b]September 25th[/b]!
[hr][/hr]
[h3][i]“When murder calls, Poirot must respond”[/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/a6d544f58721c1f478f4a308841ebb4e7fe3ab37.jpg[/img]
The world famous detective can’t seem to enjoy a single holiday in peace! Solving the awful murder of one of the Karnak’s passengers is sure to tickle his little grey cells. But is everything as straightforward as it seems?
[hr][/hr]
[h3][i]“Whatever it takes, I will bring them down”[/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/4b2595ab56cb1b06955294ebc85bbccfa8e62c27.jpg[/img]
Inspired by Poirot, Jane Royce has started to make a name for herself as a private detective. Rocked by a terrible tragedy, she’s determined to track down the murderer responsible for her loss no matter what, even if it means following them across the world.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Dive into the art of [i]Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile[/i] with the [b]Digital Deluxe Edition[/b], available on [b]September 25th[/b][/h3]

notes.notes:
Bonjour Detectives,

On [b]April 24th[/b], answer the call of exploration and set off for [b][i]Amerzone - The Explorer’s Legacy[/i][/b]!

Embark on the quest of a lifetime aboard the Hydrafloat and explore a forgotten Latin American country to fulfill the last wishes of a late explorer. Make use of your curiosity and observational skills to solve intricate puzzles and bring back the White Birds into this mysterious land.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2429190/ss_87d5dc855bac62459ab5c7900c478a5b8c1f9620.1920x1080.jpg?t=1741885639[/img]

Released in 1999, [i]Amerzone[/i] had a great impact on the adventure genre and was ahead of its time with its ecological message. This game was also the first one Benoît Sokal created before the [i][b]Syberia[/b][/i] saga.

notes.title: 🖼️ Have a first look at Death on the Nile’s vibrant world
notes.notes:
Bonjour Detectives,

We’re excited to share the very first concept art from [i]Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile[/i]! These early visuals, crafted by our team in Lyon, France, during pre-production, offer a glimpse into the game’s unique setting and atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/b8b18ece7fb67b574e0df975442483ad968bdbfb.jpg[/img]

As with [i]Agatha Christie - Murder on the Orient Express[/i], we’re taking some [b]creative liberties[/b] in this adaptation—introducing a duo of protagonists, expanding the locations beyond the cruise, and reimagining elements of the story, all while staying true to Agatha Christie’s legacy. We’ve worked closely with Agatha Christie Limited, to ensure the story, dialogues, and character behaviors honor her iconic world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/c833f2f7cce6c5b43bd2f4b5f4e68335800694ce.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/e913ae27178a13b0e0166a1cdabaa3efc7aecf1a.jpg[/img]

[b]Why the 70s?[/b] It’s a fascinating, transformative era—full of disco, cultural shifts, and evolving social dynamics. It provides a fresh yet fitting backdrop for this timeless mystery, while keeping the essence of Poirot’s investigation intact. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/1f6f1f355da487af28705e9f60432c902df57284.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/a8a3762cbd6463929bdcd236a02e68a68c5f5c08.jpg[/img]

There’s still much more to reveal, but for now, we hope you enjoy this first look!

[i]~MSLyon Team[/i]

notes.title: 🚢🌴 Crime never rests! Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile is coming in 2025
notes.notes:
Bonjour Detectives,

What was supposed to be a leisurely cruise turned into a tragedy!

Prepare your little grey cells for [i][b]Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile[/b][/i], coming in [b]2025[/b]!

https://youtu.be/deE-kzpkgNo

In [i]Death on the Nile[/i], a peaceful cruise on the Nile is disrupted by a terrible crime. Thankfully, famous detective Hercule Poirot is onboard.
Meanwhile, a private detective is tracking a murderer, leading her from London to Majorca, New York, and finally to Egypt.

The two investigations collide at Abu Simbel. The dynamic duo will solve a complex case full of twists and turns. But the story doesn’t end with the book, and it still holds many mysteries and twists, even for Agatha Christie fans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/a685c0fd943316dee4d5d441e3c65c5a1aad6585.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45348767/664ee3401511a7d92363162dbdf7610d8dafced9.png[/img]

🤝 [b]Dual Protagonists[/b] - Play as both Hercule Poirot and Jane Royce, each with unique perspectives and storylines that converge in an epic finale.

🕺 [b]Innovative Setting[/b] - Immerse yourself in this story set in the 1970s, a decade of significant social change. From feminist movements and the rise of minority rights to the liberation of societal norms, this vibrant era blends disco clubs, bell-bottoms, and psychedelia, where colorful characters bring a captivating plot to life.

📖 [b]Extended Storyline[/b] - Dive into a brand-new investigation that continues after the events of the book, ensuring fresh surprises for fans and newcomers alike.

🗺️ [b]Diverse Locations[/b] - Explore a variety of stunning locations, from the exotic Nile cruise to the bustling cities of Majorca, London, and Cairo.

🧩 [b]Enhanced Mindmap[/b] - Collect and connect facts in a dynamic mindmap to make deductions and advance the story.

⚖️ [b]Confrontation System[/b] - Use gathered evidence to confront suspects, expose lies, and uncover hidden truths.

📝 [b]Character Profiles[/b] - Complete character profiles by gathering information through dialogues and observations.

We're thrilled to bring you the latest patch for [i]Murder on the Orient Express[/i], packed with fixes and improvements to enhance your gaming experience.

Here's a quick rundown of the key changes:
[h2]General Fixes:[/h2]
[list][*]Resolved a rare issue where the first Steam achievement might not complete. Your detective skills deserve recognition!
[*]Enhanced French localization for an improved immersive experience.[/list]
[h2]Options Menu Enhancements:[/h2]
[list][*]When starting a New Game without any existing save data, the in-game voice language will automatically synchronize with the selected text language.
[*]Updated camera settings in the main menu for a more refined experience.
[*]When players deactivate subtitles in the Options menu, they are automatically reactivated each time the game is launched.[/list]
[h2]Chapter-Specific Improvements:[/h2]
[list][*]In Chapter 1, fixed a scenario where the cutscene would go away if the interaction key was spammed after inspecting Freja's dessert.
[*]Chapter 3: Ensured that quitting the game after speaking with Ms. Moreau won't prevent unlocking a mind map node.
[*]Chapter 7: Corrected the order of photos of ransom money when inspecting them, and fixed a text issue when inspecting Mr. MacQueen's photo.
[*]Chapter 13: Rectified a linguistic hiccup, replacing "St Pancreas" with the correct "St Pancras" during Mr. MacQueen's dialogue.[/list]

Thank you for your continued support, detectives! Dive back into the mystery with these improvements, and keep those gray cells active. Happy investigating! 🕵️‍♂️🔍
